description: VRL calls that pass a file, which Vector reads when it compiles the program, and how every scanner of this call must judge each program. The server (`file_argument_calls` in server/src/validation.rs), the agent (`fileArgumentCalls` in agent/internal/agent/vrl_file_arguments.go) and the dashboard (`fileArgumentCalls` in dashboard/src/vrlFileArguments.ts) read this one file in their tests, so the three scanners cannot drift. Where the readings of a program disagree, the safe answer is that it passes a file.
program_forms: A program is a string, a list of programs joined together, or {"repeat": program, "times": n} for a program repeated n times.
found_means: The labels of the functions the program calls with a file, in the order of `functions`. An empty list means no call passes one.
bounds_mean: A program past any bound is taken to pass a file. `calls` is the most calls to one function that are read, `call_bytes` the most bytes of one call, and `scan_factor` times the length of the program, plus `call_bytes`, the most bytes the scan of one function reads in all: every reading of every call, up to its closing parenthesis.
